name: agent-index-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-index on a fresh box and assert its standalone setup-gated lifecycle. It validates no-runtime, stamped-only, partial-venv, complete-runtime/no-role, configured-client, and configured-host states; status must remain non-mutating before setup, partial slots must never dispatch, and explicit setup must repair/provision the role-specific runtime. It also validates the CLI, HTTP service shell, direct `agent-index mcp` toolset, and sessionStart scope-binding hook without requiring a durable embedding model build. Distinct from agent-index-cutover, which validates graceful version cutover. Name-free / public.
validates: agent-index standalone setup gate, slot readiness, and read behavior

stages.title: dormant, stamped, and partial runtimes stay non-runnable
explicit setup repairs and provisions the host runtime
complete/no-role plus configured client/host states are explicit
standalone read/status/health verbs degrade cleanly with no built index
